title: Shadow Futures
subtitle: How Markets Choose Winners—and Lose Sight of the Alternatives
author: Martin Erlic
initial_prompt: Use case: ads-marketing. Create ONE finished, flat, front book cover, portrait 2:3 aspect ratio, ideally 2160 x 3240 pixels or higher native resolution for a 6 x 9 inch print cover at 300 dpi. A sophisticated, commercially compelling popular-economics book. Exact title in very large beautiful cream typography in the upper third: SHADOW FUTURES, stacked on two lines. Exact subtitle below the title, highly legible, elegantly broken over three lines: How Markets Choose Winners—and Lose Sight of the Alternatives. Exact author name prominently at the bottom in large widely tracked capitals: MARTIN ERLIC. The author name must have generous safe margins and be unmistakable. Palette: deep midnight petrol/navy #142c34, warm ivory #f2ede1, restrained antique gold #c99b55. Premium matte-paper editorial graphic design, precise luminous architectural geometry, very subtle paper grain. Central illustration occupying the middle-to-lower portion, between subtitle and author: a single rising solid gold geometric path/tower casts multiple impossibly branching long shadows, with faint architectural outlines of unrealized routes fading into the dark ground. A visual metaphor for one winner and the alternative futures that disappear. Striking, restrained, intelligent, unusual, not a generic financial book. Strong typographic hierarchy, crisp perfectly spelled text, generous quiet space, no clutter. Artwork must reach all four edges; every text element must be safely inset at least 7 percent of width. This is the FLAT FRONT COVER only, absolutely no book mockup, perspective, spine, page edges, background scene, crop marks, barcode, logo, bestseller claim, review quote, badge, additional text, or watermark.
final_edit_prompt: Production-resolution edit only. Preserve this exact finished book-cover design, composition, palette and all text verbatim, including the prominent author MARTIN ERLIC at the bottom. Increase native output resolution to 2048 pixels wide by 3072 pixels tall (2:3 portrait), or 2160 by 3240 if supported. This must be a higher-resolution master for a 6x9-inch print cover at at least 300 pixels per inch, with especially crisp typography and architectural linework. Do not redesign, change the wording, add new text, crop, change margins, or add a perspective/mockup. Keep exact title SHADOW FUTURES and exact subtitle How Markets Choose Winners—and Lose Sight of the Alternatives.
result_boundary: Both generations returned 1024×1536 pixels. Larger Kindle and print-size exports are resampled document renders; they are not native high-resolution artwork.
